properties.name_zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区粗略范围
properties.source_title: 依据公告重点片区名称、南北顺序、公告约面积和临时 SITE_BOUNDARY 形成的临时粗略范围
properties.derivation_method: 按公告自北向南第一处、众智园AI自主创新加速区、约192.1公顷及五环路/清河相关任务线索，在临时总体设计范围内粗略定位并校核面积；公告未给出四至，矩形边不得解释为地块或道路红线。
properties.usage_note: 仅用于 AI agent 生成、展示和临时自检；不得作为 official key-area polygon、审批依据或精确面积复算依据。
properties.adoption_note_zh: 几何逐字采用：本要素的几何与属性均原样取自组织方场地包 brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson，未作任何改动。已逐字段比对确认：source_type、source_title、derivation_method、name_zh、official_boundary、boundary_precision 与官方文件完全一致——也就是说，这些字段里「由公告文字四至推定的粗略范围」是组织方对其 provisional 几何的自述，不是本方案的推导。因此未按字面改写它们：那样做等于修改组织方的来源记录。本方案只新增 adopted_verbatim / adopted_from / adoption_note_* 说明采用关系。该边界 official_boundary=false、boundary_precision=provisional_rough，不得作为官方红线或精确面积依据；官方 polygon 发布后全部面积与比例须重算。
properties.adoption_note_en: Verbatim adoption: the geometry and properties of this feature are taken unchanged from the organiser site package brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. A field-by-field comparison confirms that source_type, source_title, derivation_method, name_zh, official_boundary and boundary_precision are identical to the official file. In other words, the wording describing a "rough extent inferred from the announcement's textual bearings" is the organiser's own account of its provisional geometry, not a derivation by this submission. Those fields are therefore deliberately left unaltered: rewriting them to "reflect verbatim adoption" would mean editing the organiser's provenance record. This submission only adds adopted_verbatim / adopted_from / adoption_note_* to state the adoption. This boundary carries official_boundary=false and boundary_precision=provisional_rough; it must not be used as an official redline or a precise area basis, and all areas and ratios must be recomputed once official polygons are released.
